description: Example documents of the JSON contracts the SDK emits, generated from the producers named here and checked by the tests named here. `schema.file` is relative to docs/contracts; `schema.ref` selects a definition inside it; schemas refer to each other by `$id`. Members at a `placeholders` JSON pointer vary between runs and carry the fixed value shown there.

fork.description: Online fork check: a Safe and an EOA account with separate payers and no gas policy, so `gas` is null and `total_budget_base_units` is absent.

production.description: Online production check: one Safe account whose payer has a gas policy with a total budget.

almanak-permissions-v1.producer: almanak.gateway.permissions.statement: the permissions block of `almanak check --production --online --json` for Safe/Roles accounts

installed.description: Every Safe already holds the generated authority: nothing pending and every bundle null.

pending.description: The first Safe owes its owner a Safe Transaction Builder batch; the second is installed.

backtest-progress-v1.producer: almanak.backtest.progress.ProgressJob: the `--progress-file` snapshot of `almanak backtest run`, driven by a fixed clock

calibrating.description: First snapshot of a run without timing history: startup active, every ETA still calibrating with null duration and finish time.

completed.description: Final snapshot of that run: every phase finished and the ETA complete at zero.

running.description: A later run of the same timing key: the simulation estimated from its observed rate, finalization from previous runs, so the run ETA is mixed. Its measured phase cannot finish within a one-hour budget.

failed.description: That run after an exception: status failed and every ETA unavailable.

interrupted.description: A run stopped by an interrupt during startup: status interrupted and every ETA unavailable.

almanak-check.producer: almanak.checks.check: the stdout document of `almanak check --online --json` that exits 0, over the committed Aave V4 resolution archive

fork_online.description: Online fork check with funding and no permissions block.

production_online_safe.description: Online production check of a Safe account with funding and permissions blocks.

almanak-check-refusal.producer: almanak.cli.error_document: the stderr line of a refused `almanak check --json`, which exits 1

permissions_refused.description: Online production check whose permissions stage failed: the stages and the funding block resolved before it survive.

backtest_refused.description: Offline backtest check refusing an inventory fund without an author account; no funding block, because backtests are not funded.

almanak-backtest-report.producer: almanak.backtest.cli.create: the stdout document of `almanak backtest run --json`, over the committed Aave V4 historical archive

historical_path.description: The Aave V4 WETH reference over twelve historical-path steps, valued in asset units only.

almanak-dashboard-response.producer: almanak.dashboard.evaluate.evaluate: the protocol-1 Response of the reference strategy's dashboard hook, evaluated in the sandbox at a fixed capture time

ready.description: The hook returned a dashboard document.

absent.description: The strategy defines no dashboard hook.

unavailable.description: The sandbox could not run the hook; the diagnostic names the exception type only.
